title: Late Rhythm
creator: FOCUS & CO
caption: Instrumental jazzy deep house, nu jazz, no vocals. Rhodes and vibraphone ninth chords, walking-style warm bassline, crisp swung hi-hats, rimshots, soft kick, a flute or muted trumpet melody that develops. Sophisticated hotel lounge. Evolving arrangement: filtered intro, chords and lead enter gradually, a breakdown without kick, then a fuller groove; the melody develops instead of looping. Hi-fi studio mix, warm and clean. Instrumental only.

title: Weekly Review
creator: FOCUS & CO
caption: Instrumental deep house, boutique, no vocals. Dub chords, Rhodes stabs, round bass between the kicks, shakers and rimshots, smooth tenor saxophone phrases now and then. Classy, groovy, upscale store. Evolving arrangement: filtered intro, chords and lead enter gradually, a breakdown without kick, then a fuller groove; the melody develops instead of looping. Hi-fi studio mix, warm and clean. Instrumental only.

title: Do Not Disturb
creator: FOCUS & CO
caption: Instrumental lounge deep house, no vocals. Warm Rhodes minor ninth chords, soft grand piano melody, round low-passed bass, steady kick, swung brushed hi-hats, light shaker, a distant muted jazz trumpet adds a few soft phrases. Elegant late-night cocktail bar. Evolving arrangement: filtered intro, chords and lead enter gradually, a breakdown without kick, then a fuller groove; the melody develops instead of looping. Hi-fi studio mix, warm and clean. Instrumental only.

title: Soft Practice
creator: FOCUS & CO
caption: Instrumental melodic deep house, no vocals. Felt piano melody, slow analog pads, plucked synth arpeggio, deep warm sub bass, soft claps, rolling percussion. Nocturnal, cinematic, focused, wide reverb. Evolving arrangement: filtered intro, chords and lead enter gradually, a breakdown without kick, then a fuller groove; the melody develops instead of looping. Hi-fi studio mix, warm and clean. Instrumental only.
